'''Ruth Lewin Sime''' is an American author, educator and scientific researcher, best known for publishing works on [[history of science]].<ref name=Guggenheim>[https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/ruth-lewin-sime/ "Ruth Lewin Sime"] at [[John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation]]. Accessed 06 February 2018.</ref> She has written several books and articles concerning nuclear physicist [[Lise Meitner]] and radiochemist [[Otto Hahn]], who were both involved in the discovery and explanation of [[nuclear fission]].<ref name=Guggenheim/>

Sime is a [[Emeritus|professor emerita]] in the Department of Chemistry at [[Sacramento City College]].

==Early life==
Sime graduated from [[Barnard College]] in 1960 and received a Ph.D. from [[Harvard University]] in 1964.
